name: SMC-CFG (megapack: sign switching, stored corrected error, auto gain)
plain: Treats the guidance difference e as a controlled signal. Each step it builds a sliding surface from how e changed against the stored corrected error, adds a bounded correction −k·sign(s) (or −k·s/‖s‖ with switching=unit), and stores the corrected error for the next step. With k = −1 the gain is chosen by model type: 0.2 on flow models and 0.01 on noise-prediction models, because, per the code comment, the paper's value wrecks SDXL images. It differs from the other SMC-CFG entries in using the sign form, storing the corrected value, and working in noise space by default (velocity on flow).
math:
e = d_c − d_u; ẽ = stored corrected error (e on the first step).
s = (e − ẽ) + λ·ẽ; u = −k·sign(s) (sign) or −k·s/‖s‖ (unit); ê = e + u; store ê.
d̂ = d_u + w·ê; k = 0.2 (flow) or 0.01 (eps) when k = −1.
